content: Notion API: pin Notion-Version 2026-03-11. Databases expose data_sources[]; rows are queried via POST /v1/data_sources/{id}/query (the old /databases/{id}/query returns 400 invalid_request_url); trash is in_trash (not archived); append positioning is position.after_block (not after); search filter values are page|data_source. The API accepted 3-level nested children in one create request (probe 2026-08-30). 404 object_not_found messages already name the integration in quotes — parse it for the not-shared error. Personal access tokens cannot list users (restricted_resource).

content: ask-colleague write with the default 20-step budget was cut before running lint on a brief that needed ~8 files read first (t4 whoami, 2026-08-30); it still delivered correct code+tests as a WIP commit. For briefs that read many files, pass --max-steps 30+ or split the brief; resume with ask-colleague resume last if cut. The local vLLM :8001 is shared with other sessions, so steps can take minutes under contention.
